test_title: PYST 1: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All T are N.

II. No M is N.

**Conclusions:**

I. All T are M.

II. Some T are not M.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Explanation : **

The Venn diagram is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f7455cddfbb8e158c9b56c39f3e5e68eecd2b6be452bc099b8a84aa610b8c3c.png] 

I. All T are M [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] Does not follow (As it is given in the statement that No M is N and all T are N, Hence T can never be M)

II. Some T are not M [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] Follow (As all T are N and No N is M. Hence T which are N will never be M.)

Hence, **Only conclusion II follows **is the correct answer.
